How to play

Use arrow keys or WASD to steer your cat parade.

  • Each fish adds a cat to your parade.
  • Hitting a wall or your own parade ends the run.
  • Earn stars at 5, 15, and 30 fish. Reach 30 to win, including on replays.
  • Each new star gives 10 coins, once. Rewards stay saved after every round.

Space, P, or Escape pauses or resumes. Switching tabs pauses automatically.
